evidence.decision: Distinguishes optional confirmation from mandatory result, static outcomes from evolving progress and essential speech from redundant visible dialogue.
evidence.artifact: Requires confirmation criteria, concrete primary label, complete dialogue, result and detail-link contract with actual intent/view changes.
evidence.transformation: Reservation example replaces vague Proceed and missing outcome with Reserve Desk, full spoken facts and a compact independent result.
evidence.verification: Checks cancel/confirm/failure, large text height, audio-only understanding and long detail; absent results or premature success fails.
evidence.applicability: Preserves compact height/Dynamic Type source qualification and TV/visionOS/Watch exclusion; native intent execution remains separate evidence.
evidence.handoffs: App Shortcuts supplies invocation and Live Activities handles evolving progress instead of indefinitely current static snippets.
evidence.distinctiveness: Confirmation-versus-result semantics and complete eyes-away speech distinguish snippet design from ordinary cards.
